# [pixi](../../index.md) [global](../index.md) exclude-newer

Manage the `exclude-newer` configuration of the global manifest

--8<-- "docs/reference/cli/pixi/global/exclude-newer_extender:description"

## Usage
```
pixi global exclude-newer [COMMAND]
```

## Subcommands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`get`](get.md) | Show the `exclude-newer` configuration |
| [`set`](set.md) | Set the cutoff, packages uploaded after it are excluded from the solve. |
| [`unset`](unset.md) | Remove the cutoff, packages uploaded after it are no longer excluded |
| [`exempt`](exempt.md) | Exempt package releases from the cutoff. |
| [`unexempt`](unexempt.md) | Remove the exemptions of packages. |


## Description
Manage the `exclude-newer` configuration of the global manifest.

Packages uploaded after the cutoff are excluded from the solve of every global environment, except for the exempted releases. The environments are synced after every change, which is reverted if the sync fails.
